chunks: We created you from the earth and will revert you back to it; and raise you up from it a second time.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between humans and the earth according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse serves as a rhetorical argument for the Resurrection (Ma'ad), emphasizing the tangible, physical nature of human creation from the earth to validate the possibility of bodily revival. Shia exegetes often highlight this triad of origin, return, and emergence as a logical proof for the Day of Judgment, reinforcing the belief in physical resurrection rather than purely spiritual ascension.
